User is planning a long-weekend family movie marathon with childhood classics and MCU films. They have watched 12 films in the last 3 months, including 5 MCU films. Confirmed lineup: *The Lion King*, *Back to the Future*, and *The Goonies*; they previously selected *Spider-Man: Homecoming* for a family movie night. *The NeverEnding Story* was considered but postponed because younger children may find it too intense.

Planned themed activities/snacks include a *Goonies*-inspired treasure hunt with clues, popcorn and other movie snacks, movie trivia, quote-along competition, and a “guess the movie poster” game using printed posters, possibly cropped, across genres/eras, with time limits and small rewards such as popcorn or candy. For the Marvel/Spider-Man night, they want snacks, a Marvel photo booth with masks, capes, web shooters, superhero emblems, fake Avengers IDs, Captain America’s shield, Thor’s hammer, and Iron Man gear. DIY signs will read “Spider-Man’s Neighborhood” and “Queens, NY.” The backdrop is an easy, customizable cardboard-box cityscape decorated as New York buildings, with webs, Spider-Man logos, fairy lights, and other details.
